sloka: पिता हि भवति ज्येष्ठो धर्मम् आर्यस्य जानतः ।तस्य पादौ ग्रहीष्यामि स हि इदानीम् गतिर् मम ॥२-७२-३३॥
transliteration: pitā hi bhavati jyeṣṭho dharmam āryasya jānataḥ ।tasya pādau grahīṣyāmi sa hi idānīm gatir mama ॥2-72-33॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ To one who knows the ways of righteousness the elder brother is (like) the father. Indeed, he (Rama) is my refuge and I shall hold his feet now.
